candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment of guesses[msg.sender].block to set it to block.number (current block) instead of block.number + 1, so the stored block differs after lockInGuess.
Set guesses[msg.sender].block to block.number + 2 (two blocks ahead) instead of block.number + 1, altering the stored block value after lockInGuess.
Remove the assignment to guesses[msg.sender].block entirely (delete that statement), leaving the block value unchanged (zero) after lockInGuess.
Swap order: set guesses[msg.sender].block before assigning guesses[msg.sender].guess, which changes intermediate state observable if a reentrant call occurs during assignment (ordering change).
Assign a constant nonzero block value (1) to guesses[msg.sender].block instead of using block.number + 1, changing the stored block after lockInGuess.
Replace the comparison that checks answer != 0 with equality check answer == 0, inverting the guard so payout happens only when blockhash is zero.
Change the reset of guesses[msg.sender].block to zero to occur after the payout, so the block marker remains until after transfer attempt.
Remove the check that block.number is greater than the stored block so settle can be called in the same block as the guess was locked in.
Change the require that guesses[msg.sender].block != 0 to require it equals zero, effectively preventing settlement when a guess is present and allowing only when none set.
